platform_contract.POSIX: Named sequences only from terminfo or its explicitly declared normal ECMA protocol; other sequences return unknown with all bytes. Physical modifiers/key-up remain unknown. Existing OS CR input translation is preserved.
platform_contract.Windows: Native ReadConsoleInputW/PeekConsoleInputW plus existing strict UTF16 transcoding/carry. Native ECHO_INPUT/LINE_INPUT restrictions require targeted native acceptance.
platform_contract.ownership: Borrowed endpoints unchanged, no hidden tty/handle, no process-wide signal/code-page/descriptor flag changes. Mode state belongs to existing native Session/Streams; managed aliases share one identity.
platform_contract.failure: read_key partial/count describes consumed input bytes, including failures during explicit echo. Do not retry a read to repair output. Saved state remains for retry when the OS refuses restoration. Entered uncancellable borrowed syscall and host-lifetime caveats remain.
platform_contract.embedding: Context::close and Runtime::close now return console::Error, source-compatible for callers discarding it; embedding callers must rebuild with matching headers/archive and inspect failures when required. No stable old C++ binary ABI claimed.
